title: CampusConnect Portal
blurb: A unified student-services portal: timetables, announcements and room booking.
description:
CampusConnect brings everyday student services into one place: personal timetables, announcements from departments, and room booking for study groups.

## What you will learn
- Designing a REST API and a React front end that talk to each other
- Role-based access for students, lecturers and staff
- Database modelling in PostgreSQL and writing safe migrations

title: PipelineKit
blurb: Reusable CI/CD templates so every lab project builds, tests and deploys the same way.
description:
PipelineKit is a library of ready-made CI/CD workflows so every lab project builds, tests and deploys the same way.

## Goals
- One-line adoption: copy a workflow and go
- Dependency caching and test sharding built in
- Security scans on every pull request

title: HealthTrack API
blurb: A documented REST API with OpenAPI specs, auth and 90%+ automated test coverage.
description:
HealthTrack API is a documented REST API built test-first. It is our reference project for API design, validation and automated testing.

## Highlights
- OpenAPI specification generated from code
- 90%+ test coverage on business logic
- Token authentication and rate limiting

title: ReviewBot
blurb: A GitHub app that lints pull requests and checks them against our review checklist.
description:
ReviewBot is a GitHub app that checks every pull request against the lab's review checklist and leaves friendly, specific comments.

## Planned checks
- Missing tests or description
- Very large diffs
- Secrets accidentally committed

title: EduMetrics Dashboard
blurb: Interactive analytics that help lecturers see which topics learners find hardest.
description:
EduMetrics turns anonymised quiz and assignment data into interactive charts that help lecturers see which topics learners find hardest.

## Focus areas
- Data cleaning and privacy by design
- Interactive visualisation with D3
- Clear, accessible dashboards

title: OpenKit UI
blurb: An accessible, well-tested React component library maintained by the whole collective.
description:
OpenKit UI is an accessible React component library maintained by the whole collective, with a documented design system and Storybook.

## Principles
- Keyboard and screen-reader friendly by default
- Every component has tests and stories
- Semantic versioning and a public changelog
